title: Fourier coefficients of coordinate projection
statement: For every natural number $n$, every sign-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and coordinate sets $J,T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the projection of $f$ onto coordinates in $J$ is the Fourier coefficient of its real-valued version at $T$ if $T\subseteq J$, and is zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
